sentences.text: Adult specimens of this large, robust theropod reached lengths of up to 8 meters.
Its most striking feature was a unique nasal crest that rose vertically from the skull and fanned out over the eyes.
Younger individuals were estimated to measure between 6 and 7 meters in length and weigh from 350 to 465 kilograms.
Paleontologist Dr. William Hammer first excavated the species in 1991 from the Hanson Formation.
Additional material was unearthed in 2013, though a full description of these remains has not yet been published.
Long cervical ribs found inside the mouth of the type specimen led to a hypothesis that the animal was feeding on a prosauropod when it died.
Dr. Hammer concluded that a tooth from a tritylodont was present in the stomach contents at the time of death.
Pathological marks on some bones provide evidence that these animals engaged in scavenging behavior.
Broken teeth from a juvenile individual found nearby suggest it shed its teeth naturally while scavenging an adult carcass.
Analysis indicates the brain was more primitive compared to those of other theropods.
Studies suggest the distinctive crest was used for intra-species recognition.

The animal is currently classified as a derived neotheropod closely related to Averostra, though a 2020 study by Adam Marsh and Timothy Rowe classified it as a basal neotheropod, and its classification remains debated due to its mix of primitive and advanced characteristics.
Cryolophosaurus lived during the Early Jurassic Period, approximately 196 to 188 million years ago.
Fossils were found about 650 kilometers from the South Pole, which was located approximately 1000 kilometers farther north during the time the animal lived.
The classification of Cryolophosaurus remains debated due to its mix of primitive and advanced characteristics.
Researchers challenged the idea that the bizarre crest and armor were primarily for mating, fighting rivals, or intimidating predators.
In 2019, the species recognition function of the crest was disputed, while a socio-sexual display model was suggested.
